title: Friction log: where the API did not do what we expected
blurb: Every place found so far where HTML-in-canvas, or a Chrome API used with it, did not do what the person writing a page expected. Each entry has what was expected, what happened, the browser, where to see it, the workaround and a status: browser bug, API gap, the API as built, or our mistake. Nineteen entries are re-run in the visitor's browser.
question: Where did HTML-in-canvas not do what a developer expected, and for each case is it a browser bug, a gap in the API, the API working as built, or a mistake in the page?
result: 79 entries on 2026-11-21: 18 that look like browser bugs, 17 API gaps, 21 where the API works as built, 8 mistakes of ours, 7 from libraries or the test browser, 8 with no known cause. All 19 probes reproduce in Chromium 157.
